en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 1. All of my scholars narrated to me from Sa’d (ibn ‘Abdillāh), from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, from Dāwūd Al-Sarmi, who said:
I heard Abā Ja’far the Second (Imam Jawād (a.s.)) say: Those who go to the Ziyārah of the grave of my father (Imam Riďā (a.s.)) will be rewarded with Paradise.
